WITH scoped AS (
SELECT f.filled_at, f.raw_fill_json->>'created_time' AS created_time,
f.raw_fill_json->>'ts' AS exchange_ts
FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id
AND o.id=(SELECT min(x.id) FROM live_orders x WHERE x.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id)
WHERE o.strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%'
), parsed AS (
SELECT *,created_time::timestamptz AS execution_time,exchange_ts::numeric AS epoch_seconds FROM scoped
)
SELECT count(*) AS fills,count(*) FILTER (WHERE execution_time IS NOT NULL) AS raw_time_present,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE epoch_seconds IS NOT NULL) AS raw_epoch_present,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE floor(extract(epoch FROM execution_time))=epoch_seconds) AS raw_fields_agree_to_second,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE filled_at>=execution_time) AS collected_after_execution,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE filled_at<execution_time) AS collected_before_execution,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE filled_at IS NULL) AS source_time_missing,
min(extract(epoch FROM filled_at-execution_time)) AS minimum_collection_lag_seconds,
max(extract(epoch FROM filled_at-execution_time)) AS maximum_collection_lag_seconds
FROM parsed
